draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to all three customer-service domains not seen in training (Insurance 85.7 vs 81.2, Telecom 83.9 vs 80.4, Utilities 86.2 vs 82.0 macro-F1).
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The sentence's "may extend" is weaker than the evidence, which shows a consistent advantage across all evaluated held-out domains. No statistical test reported, so keep hedged but can state the observed advantage.
